Company Org is the canonical routing reference for every task.

executives: Chief of Staff
CEO-facing router. Prioritizes, compresses updates, assigns work, keeps the CEO out of weeds.
Personal Assistant
Calendar, Gmail, contacts, personal logistics, reminders, purchases, admin follow-up.
CDO
Data, analytics, modeling, metrics, quality, reporting, ML, experimentation.
CTO
Architecture, repos, implementation, CI/CD, deployments, integrations, review worker.
CFO
Costs, subscriptions, pricing, budgets, monetization, free-first guardrails.

Brand, growth, SEO, copy, content, positioning, launch messaging.
COO
Execution systems, SOPs, release coordination, operating cadence.
PRO
Product & Review Officer. UX, review readiness, feedback capture, acceptance criteria.
CHRO
Agent roles, training, hiring logic, evals, workload design.
CHO
Founder energy, health, happiness, focus load, burnout prevention.
CCO
Customer support, customer research, docs, help flows, user feedback.
CSO
Security, privacy, auth, secrets, safe public/private boundaries.
CIO
Knowledge system, docs, context, file registry, decision memory.
workflows: Start every task by identifying the executive owner and specialist agents from Company_Org.md.
Check Priority 1, blocked work, needs-review work, open inbox, and next action. Output: short CEO brief.
Send one command from this page. Success only counts after the webhook confirms GitHub sync.
Chief of Staff routes to one executive owner; workers report upward, not directly to CEO.
Inspect repo, preserve architecture, change the smallest useful slice, run checks, report proof.
Use the HVAC app style: in-app overlay on the real screen, live/sync/failed/blocked states, no fake saved state, screenshot support where possible.
Mobile load, core buttons, links, build/CI, review webhook, and no secrets before CEO review.
